scenarios.title: Connection and initial dump
steps: Start capture before connecting the official editor to the DSP204.
Set the official editor Online.
Wait until presets and current state are loaded, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Gain / mute / phase
steps: Open Gain.
On InA, set Gain to -6.0 dB, then click Action done.
On InA, enable Mute, then click Action done.
On InA, switch Normal to Inverse, then click Action done.
On Out1, switch Normal to Inverse, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Matrix routing + attenuation
steps: Open Matrix.
Route InA to Out1 only, then click Action done.
On Out1/InA, set gain to -6.0 dB, then click Action done.
On Out1/InA, set gain to -60.0 dB, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Gate / Comp / Limit
steps: Open Gate, on InA set Threshold to -40.0 dB, then click Action done.
Open Comp, on Out1 set Threshold to -20.0 dB, then click Action done.
On Out1, set Ratio to 1:4.0, then click Action done.
Open Limit, on Out1 set Threshold to -10.0 dB, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Delay
steps: Open Delay.
In ms, set InA to 1.000 ms, then click Action done.
In ms, set Out1 to 10.000 ms, then click Action done.
Switch unit to m and ft, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: PEQ / GEQ / filters
steps: Open InA.
PEQ Band 1: set Gain to +3.0 dB, then click Action done.
HighPass: set 315.0 Hz and BW -24 slope, then click Action done.
Open GEQ, set 1 kHz to +3.0 dB, then click Action done.
Click EQ Bypass, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Channel Name + Test Tone
steps: Open Channel Name, rename InA to 12345678, click Set, then Action done.
Rename Out4 to 12345678, click Set, then Action done.
Open Test Tone, select Pink Noise, then click Action done.
Select Sine Wave 1 kHz, then click Action done.
